title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews
abstract: arXiv:2604.05163v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Qualitative interviews provide essential insights into human experiences when they elicit high-quality responses. While qualitative and NLP researchers have proposed various measures of interview quality, these measures lack validation that high-scoring responses actually contribute to the study's goals. In this work, we identify, implement, and evaluate 10 proposed measures of interview response quality to determine which are actually predictive of a response's contribution to the study findings. To conduct our analysis, we introduce the Qualitative Interview Corpus, a newly constructed dataset of 343 interview transcripts with 16,940 participant responses from 14 real research projects. We find that direct relevance to a key research question is the strongest predictor of response quality. translated_title: 何为优质回答？定性访谈回答质量的实证分析
translated_abstract: 当定性访谈能够引出高质量回答时，它可以为人类体验提供重要洞见。尽管定性研究与自然语言处理（NLP）领域的研究者已提出多种衡量访谈质量的指标，但这些指标缺乏验证，即高分回答是否真正有助于实现研究目标。在本研究中，我们识别、实现并评估了10种已被提出的访谈回答质量衡量指标，以确定哪些指标真正能够预测回答对研究发现的贡献。为开展分析，我们构建并引入了定性访谈语料库，这是一个全新构建的数据集，包含来自14个真实研究项目的343份访谈记录和16,940条参与者回答。我们发现，与研究核心问题的直接相关性是回答质量的最强预测因子。此外，我们还发现，常用于评估NLP访谈系统的两个指标——清晰度和基于意外度的信息量——并（不具备预测性）。
tldr: 本研究通过构建包含14个真实研究项目、343份访谈记录和16,940条回答的定性访谈语料库，评估了10种回答质量指标，发现与研究问题的直接相关性是预测回答质量的最强因素，而NLP访谈系统评估中常用的清晰度和基于意外度的信息量指标并不具预测性。
en_tdlr: This study constructs the Qualitative Interview Corpus (343 transcripts and 16,940 responses from 14 real research projects) to evaluate 10 proposed measures of interview response quality, finding that direct relevance to key research questions is the strongest predictor of quality, while clarity and surprisal-based informativeness—commonly used in NLP interview evaluation—are not predictive.
